provenance.note: Published ESMFold2 models with stable neutral display aliases; numbers are identifiers, not rankings. The displayed target is a single group reference. Binders are rigidly target-aligned into this comparison frame. Original pairs remain in a separate lesson and in the retained source files. Contact sidechains are proximity-only selections calculated against the displayed geometry. Exact transforms, hashes, identities and credits are in binder-gallery/manifest.json. These 17 designs meet the published binder criteria; they are not a ranked top 17. Adaptyv KD is a published binding measurement, not a neutralization result; ≤ marks an upper bound and ≈ an approximate fit.
